description: Tests the ability to navigate to the privacy policy page from the login page, ensuring the link works correctly.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Locate the 'Privacy Policy' link in the footer.
Redirect to the privacy policy page at https://roost.ai/privacy-policy.
Verify that the privacy policy page loads with the expected content.
expected_results: User is redirected to the privacy policy page upon clicking the link.
Privacy policy page displays the correct and complete content.
edge_cases: Privacy policy link leads to a 404 error.
Network timeout while accessing the privacy policy page.
Footer link is not visible due to display issues.
Redirection loop prevents access to the privacy policy page.
Privacy policy page content fails to load completely.
data_requirements: Footer link must be correctly configured.
Privacy policy page must exist and be accessible.
Application must have valid SSL certificates.
Browser cache settings should allow redirection.
dependencies: Privacy policy page must be live and accessible.
Footer link must be correctly implemented in the HTML.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the privacy policy page.
Redirect latency after clicking the link.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Privacy Policy' link is keyboard-accessible.
Validate ARIA labels for the footer link.
Confirm privacy policy content readability for screen readers.
